notes.title: 3.21 Update
notes.content:
1. Make all heroes' fixed skills available in the common card pool to enrich the tactics. (For example, players can obtain the trap skill even without the hero "Goshawk".)
2. Fix the bu:
g where players pick up the treasure chest in the campaign "Forest Shrine" but don't get any food.

notes.title: 3.20 Update
notes.content: Added the Skill Fusion feature: We have added 3 fusion-based skills, with more to come soon!

notes.title: Update of Version 0.7.4 - New Pre-battle Layout & Hero Encyclopedia Added
0.7.2Version update
notes.content:
The battle mode changes from the original 40 - health - point setting to a status - bar plan. With the ebb and flow of the battle, there are stone giants that can help with defense and a final fortress on the status - bar.

Guess: A guessing mini-game is added to the start menu. You can bet 5 gold coins to guess which side, the red team or the green team, will win (with random heroes and random skills).

notes.title: 0.6.0版本更新;
notes.content:
The following have been added to the gold coin store: two heroes and two exclusive skills for heroes (you need to purchase the skills too, otherwise you won't be able to use any skills if you choose a new hero).
The page of the gold coin store still has some areas that could be improved. In order to let everyone get their hands on the new heroes sooner, the update is being released first.
The new hero, the Rabbit, is extremely interesting (you'll know why it's called the Rabbit once you play).
